/*selectSellerMpIvTranStatementPrintDeleteList*/ SELECT S.BUYER_NAME , S.PO_CREATE_DATE , S.PO_NO , S.INV_NO , S.PO_AMT , S.DS_DATE , S.INVOICE_DATE , S.PO_REMARK , S.DS_ITEM_CNT , S.BUYER , S.SELLER , S.PROCESS_TYPE , S.LEGACY_PO_NO , S.REF_IF_NO , S.TR_BUYER , S.DELY_TO_LOCATION , S.ADD_USER_ID , S.DI_REMAIN_QTY , S.GR_REMAIN_QTY , S.DELIVERY_QTY , S.GR_QTY , S.REF_PR_NO , S.WMS_GR_QTY , S.BUYER2 , S.REF_NO , CASE WHEN NVL(S.PROCESS_TYPE,' ') = '0' THEN ( SELECT X.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL FROM ICOMIVHD X WHERE 1=1 AND X.BUYER = S.BUYER AND X.INV_NO = S.INV_NO AND NVL(X.STATUS,' ') != 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) ELSE '' END AS LEGACY_INVOICE_KEY , DECODE(S.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','') AS BFRE_STCK_YN , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = S.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME , (SELECT USR.PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = S.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_PHONE_NUMBER , S.PARCEL_YN_TEXT , S.INV_REMARK FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(E ICOMIVHD_02) INDEX(D ICOMIVDT_03) */ MAX(F_GET_EXPORT_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, B.PO_NO, B.DELY_TO_LOCATION)) AS BUYER_NAME -- 1 구매사 , MAX(A.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE -- 2 발주일 , MAX(A.PO_NO) AS PO_NO -- 3 발주번호 , DECODE(COUNT(DISTINCT D.INV_NO), 1, MAX(D.INV_NO), 'plural_inv.gif') AS INV_NO -- 4 거래명세서번호 , SUM(DECODE(A.PR_TYPE,'PX', B.AGENT_PRICE, B.UNIT_PRICE)*D.INV_QTY) AS PO_AMT -- 5 납품총금액 , MIN(C.DS_DATE) DS_DATE -- 6 납품예정일 , MAX(D.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE -- 7 납품일 , MAX(DECODE(A.BUYER,'KREMK20001', DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','',A.PO_REMARK), A.PO_REMARK)) AS PO_REMARK -- 8 비고 , COUNT(*) AS DS_ITEM_CNT -- 9 납품품목수 , D.BUYER AS BUYER -- 10 , MAX(B.SELLER) AS SELLER -- 11 , MAX(A.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE , MAX(DECODE(TRIM(B.LEGACY_PO_NO), NULL,'N',B.LEGACY_PO_NO)) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , MAX(B.REF_IF_NO) AS REF_IF_NO , MAX(DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',B.WAREHOUSE_CODE,B.BUYER)) AS TR_BUYER , MAX(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , MAX(A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID , (SUM(NVL(D.INV_QTY,0)) - SUM(NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0))) AS DI_REMAIN_QTY , (SUM(NVL(D.INV_QTY,0)) - SUM(NVL(D.GR_QTY,0))) AS GR_REMAIN_QTY , SUM(NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0)) AS DELIVERY_QTY , SUM(NVL(D.GR_QTY,0)) AS GR_QTY , MAX(B.REF_PR_NO) AS REF_PR_NO , SUM(NVL(D.WMS_GR_QTY,0)) AS WMS_GR_QTY , MAX(DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE,'X',DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',B.WAREHOUSE_CODE,F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, '01')),F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, '01'))) AS BUYER2 , MAX(F.REF_NO ) AS REF_NO --PX번호 , MAX(A.DOC_TYPE) AS DOC_TYPE , MAX((SELECT MAX(MNG.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_ID FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MNG.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND MNG.STATUS != 'O')) AS KEP_USER_ID , DECODE(NVL(MAX(E.PARCEL_YN),MAX(A.PARCEL_YN)), 'Y', '택배', '자차') AS PARCEL_YN_TEXT , MAX(E.REMARK_INV) AS INV_REMARK FROM ICOMIVHD E , ICOMIVDT D , ICOMPOHD A , ICOMPODT B , ICOMPORS C, ICOMPRDT F WHERE E.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND E.INV_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND (B.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} OR B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_buyer_code})
AND (B.PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_po_no}||'%') OR B.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_po_no}||'%'))
AND E.BUYER = D.BUYER AND E.INV_NO = D.INV_NO AND E.SELLER = D.SELLER AND D.BUYER = C.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND D.DS_DATE= C.DS_DATE AND D.BUYER = B.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND D.BUYER = A.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.BUYER = F.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = F.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = F.PR_SEQ AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND F.STATUS <> 'D'
AND (NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0) > 0 OR NVL(D.GR_QTY,0) > 0 )
AND (NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0) = 0 AND NVL(D.GR_QTY,0) = 0)
GROUP BY D.BUYER , D.PO_NO , D.DS_DATE , D.INV_NO ORDER BY BUYER_NAME, PO_NO ) S
